sql:
select
        distinct ei1_0.course_code,
        c1_0.course_code,
        c1_0.category,
        c1_0.course_name,
        c1_0.course_name_th,
        c1_0.credits,
        ei1_0.course_name_th,
        ei1_0.interest_group,
        ei1_0.requires_quota,
        t1_0.course_code,
        t1_0.tag 
    from
        elective_info ei1_0 
    join
        course c1_0 
            on c1_0.course_code=ei1_0.course_code 
    left join
        elective_tag t1_0 
            on ei1_0.course_code=t1_0.course_code 
    where
        c1_0.category=N'FREE_ELECTIVE' 
        and exists(select
            1 from elective_review_point d1_0 
        where
            ei1_0.course_code=d1_0.course_code) 
        and exists(select
            1 from section s1_0 
        where
            s1_0.course_code=c1_0.course_code 
            and s1_0.academic_year=?) 
        and (
            ? is null 
            or ei1_0.interest_group=?
        ) 
        and (
            upper(c1_0.course_code) like (?+'%') escape '!' 
            or upper(c1_0.course_name) like (?+'%') escape '!' 
            or upper(c1_0.course_name) like ('% '+?+'%') escape '!' 
            or upper(c1_0.course_name) like ('%-'+?+'%') escape '!' 
            or upper(ei1_0.course_name_th) like ('%'+?+'%') escape '!'
        )
    select
        s1_0.section_id,
        s1_0.academic_year,
        s1_0.course_code,
        c1_0.course_code,
        c1_0.category,
        c1_0.course_name,
        c1_0.course_name_th,
        c1_0.credits,
        s1_0.instructor,
        s1_0.section_no,
        s1_0.semester,
        s2_0.section_id,
        s2_0.slot_id,
        s2_0.day_of_week,
        s2_0.end_time,
        s2_0.room,
        s2_0.start_time 
    from
        section s1_0 
    join
        course c1_0 
            on c1_0.course_code=s1_0.course_code 
    left join
        schedule_slot s2_0 
            on s1_0.section_id=s2_0.section_id 
    where
        c1_0.course_code in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) 
        and s1_0.academic_year=? 
    order by
        c1_0.course_code,
        s1_0.semester,
        s1_0.section_no
